card.occupation: IT systems technician at a large parcel distribution centre near Junction 10 of the M6. He keeps the handheld scanners, label printers, sortation-line PCs and site Wi-Fi running, mostly on 12-hour rotating shifts. He regularly takes extra overtime, so his weeks often run past 50 hours.
card.education_detail: Left a Walsall comprehensive with GCSEs, then did a Level 3 BTEC in IT at Walsall College. Started as an agency picker at the depot, moved into the IT team after covering for a technician, and has since done the CompTIA A+ and an in-house networking course paid for by the employer.
card.household: Lives with his wife, Jade (27, works part-time on the tills at a garden centre), in a rented two-bed terrace in Bloxwich. No children yet. They have a staffie cross called Diesel.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Walsall. His dad drove HGVs and his mum did cleaning work. There is a big extended family on both sides within a few miles, and Sunday dinner at his mum's happens most weeks he isn't on shift. He keeps any views on religion to himself.
card.professional_persona: Competent and unflappable. When a sorter line goes down at 3am he just gets on with it, without panicking or making a fuss. He's not one for team meetings or chat on the radio. He is quite open that he's in it for the money: he chases overtime, knows exactly what each shift pattern pays, and isn't above letting a quick fix look harder than it was. He'd move firms for a couple of grand more without much loyalty.
card.sports_persona: Follows Walsall FC loosely and checks scores on his phone. He goes to the odd home game at the Bescot with his brother-in-law. Doesn't play anything organised now. He keeps fit through walking the dog and a cheap 24-hour gym he uses after night shifts, when it's empty.
card.arts_persona: Not really into arts. Watches crime documentaries and true-crime series on Netflix, and YouTube videos about PC builds and car detailing. Listens to drum and bass and older garage in the car on the way to shifts.
card.travel_persona: Holidays are a week somewhere hot and cheap: they've done Tenerife twice and Turkey once, all-inclusive, mostly lying by the pool. He'd quite like to go to Japan one day for the tech and the cars, but says it's 'not happening any time soon' on what they've got.
card.culinary_persona: Plain eater. Bacon or sausage on a bap before or after a shift, meal deals, and Jade's spag bol or chilli for tea. Friday is chippy or a Chinese takeaway. He'll do a decent barbecue in summer and is a bit proud of it. Drinks energy drinks far too much on nights.
hobbies_and_interests: playing online shooters, usually with the mic off
buying broken electronics off Facebook Marketplace, fixing them and reselling for a profit
car detailing on his ten-year-old Golf
walking Diesel round the Reedswood Park area
skills: staying calm under pressure on night shifts
card.career_goals: Wants to get into a network engineer or infrastructure role, ideally day shifts, on £35k plus. He's half-heartedly working towards a CCNA. Mostly he wants enough money to buy a house before they have kids. He'd go contracting if he thought the money was better.
card.voice: Quiet, low and fairly flat, with a light Black Country edge in the vowels rather than heavy dialect. Speaks in short answers and doesn't volunteer much unless asked directly. He says 'yeah' a lot, sometimes 'er' before answering, and 'sort of' or 'kind of' when he's unsure. He'll occasionally say 'give it me' or call a roll a bap without thinking. Says 'tea' for his evening meal. He isn't bothered by silence: he'll just wait for the next question rather than fill the gap. He might say 'sorry, what was that?' if the audio drops. He perks up slightly and talks more when the subject is PCs or making a bit of money.
card.typing: Quick and minimal. All lowercase, no full stops at the end, apostrophes often dropped ('dont', 'im'). Uses 'tbh', 'idk' and 'ye' sometimes. One-line answers unless the question forces more.
card.with_strangers: Reserved and a bit hard to read at first. He's polite enough but gives little away, and can come across as uninterested when he's just not a talker. He isn't nervous at all. He's quite matter-of-fact about wanting the participant payment.
small_things: just finished a night shift and is knackered
Diesel chewed the settee cushion again
got a graphics card off Marketplace that was cheaper than it should've been
petrol prices on the drive to the depot
deeper_things: he and Jade have been trying for a baby and it hasn't happened yet
worries that renting forever is where they're heading
sometimes feels a bit jealous of mates who went to uni and earn more for fewer hours
has stretched the truth on a reseller listing more than once and doesn't feel that bad about it
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam, slightly below eye level so the camera looks up a little. He's sitting on a sofa in the evening, lit mainly by a ceiling light behind and to the left, so his face is a bit shadowed and the screen glow gives a cool tint. Clean-shaven with light stubble, short brown hair faded at the sides, no glasses. Expression neutral and slightly tired, mouth closed, looking just off the lens at the screen. He's wearing a dark grey work-issue fleece with a small logo over the chest, zipped halfway over a black T-shirt. Behind him is a magnolia wall with a framed canvas print of him and Jade on a beach, and a TV on a black stand to one side with a games console underneath. Part of a dog bed with a chewed tennis ball is visible on the floor at the edge of the frame.
